    m.id AS movement_id,
    m.dt_op,
    m.qty,
    p.title AS part_title,
    p_price.minor AS price,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind_cd = 'IN' THEN m.qty * p_price.minor ELSE 0 END) AS net_in,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind_cd = 'OUT' THEN m.qty * p_price.minor ELSE 0 END) AS net_out,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind_cd = 'IN' THEN m.qty * p_price.minor ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind_cd = 'OUT' THEN m.qty * p_price.minor ELSE 0 END) AS net_value

    mov m
JOIN 
    part p ON m.part_id = p.id
JOIN 
    part_price p_price ON m.part_id = p_price.part_id AND m.dt_op BETWEEN p_price.valid_from AND p_price.valid_to
GROUP BY 
    m.id, m.dt_op, m.qty, p.title, p_price.minor
ORDER BY 
    m.dt_op
